text.en:
Subject to the approval of the majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite to be held in the
Municipality of Matalam, Province of North Cotabato, the barangays of Antipas, Camutan, Dolores, Kiyab,
Luhong, Magsaysay, Malangag, Malatab, and New Pontevedra, are hereby separated from said municipality
and constituted into a distinct and independent municipality in the same province to be known as the
Municipality of Antipas, with its seat of government in the present site of Barangay Antipas.

The Municipality of Antipas shall be bounded as follows:
"The point of origin is the junction of Kadauman Creek and Arakan River, point (1); thence follow the
upstream course of Arakan River to a common point boundary of Lot Nos. 2, 36 and 289, all of Pls-826,
Block I at the southern bank of said river, point (2); thence southwesterly following the lot road to its
intersection with another lot road which is a common border of Lot Nos. 10, 11, 23 and 24 all of Pls-829,
Block I, point (3); thence southeasterly following the said lot road to its intersection with Malire Creek, point
(4); thence southeasterly following the course of said creek to its junction with Camutan Creek, point (5);
thence follow the upstream course of Camutan Creek at an approximate distance of 10 kilometers to the
western corners of Lot Nos. 852 and 1253 all of Pls-79 adjoining the said creek, point (6); thence follow the
southern boundary line of Pls-79 Case 2 in a generally southwesterly direction to a common southwestern
corner monument of Lot Nos. 488 and 292 all of Pls-79 Case 2, a point on the amended boundary line of the
Municipalities of Matalam and President Roxas (Please refer to Provincial Board Resolution No. 171 s-1970),
point (7); thence northerly following the said amended boundary in an imaginary straight line to the junction
of Dalapuan River and Kinilid Creek, point (8); thence still following the said amended boundary northward
up to the junction of Kadauman Creek and Arakan River, the point of origin."
